lemma tilt_hasDerivAt (b : ℝ) (x : α) : HasDerivAt (tilt μ H · x) (tiltSlope μ H b x) b := by
  have hz := h.Z_pos (μ:=μ) b
  have he : (tiltSlope μ H b x) = - (-(mean μ H b) * Z μ H b) / Z μ H b ^ 2 * factor H b x +
      (Z μ H b)⁻¹ * (factor H b x * (-H x)) := by unfold tiltSlope tilt; field_simp; ring
  rw [he]
  exact ((h.Z_hasDerivAt b).inv hz.ne').mul (factor_hasDerivAt H b x)

proof_context.conclusion: `tilt_hasDerivAt` gives the β-derivative of `tilt` as `tilt * (mean - H)`, the density times the centred energy.

lemma continuous_activities (hc : StableActivities P T s) (U : Config G n) :
    ContinuousOn (fun x => (T x).activities.additive P U) s ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => (T x).activities.gas P U) s := by
  constructor <;> (intro x hx; apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr; intro ε he
                   filter_upwards [h.uniform_activities hc hx ε he] with y hy
                   rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]; first | exact (hy U).1 | exact (hy U).2)

proof_context.conclusion: `continuous_activities` gives continuity of the activities in the parameter on a set `s` from stability.

structure Moves (s : Signed) (b : Site n) where
  ep : Equiv.Perm ℕ
  kp : Equiv.Perm ℕ
  reg_site (i : ℕ) : (A.reg (ep i)).site = affine s b (A.reg i).site
  reg_support (i : ℕ) : (A.reg (ep i)).support = (A.reg i).support.image (affine s b)
  forced_support (i : ℕ) : (A.forced (kp i)).support = (A.forced i).support.image (affine s b)
  forced_inventory (i : ℕ) : (A.forced (kp i)).inventory = (A.forced i).inventory.image (affine s b)
  forced_tests (i : ℕ) (U : Config G n) : (A.forced (kp i)).extraTest U ↔ (A.forced i).extraTest (pull s b U)
  valuesE (i : ℕ) (U : Config G n) : A.E (ep i) U = A.E i (pull s b U)
  valuesK (i : ℕ) (U : Config G n) : A.K (kp i) U = A.K i (pull s b U)

proof_context.conclusion: `Moves` transports activities, supports, inventories and values by a signed translation `affine s b`.
